name: Reel 'Em In
text:
Requirements You're wielding a harpoon, a spear weapon, or a net attached to a rope.

---
You've developed combat techniques inspired by the methods fishermen use to catch large fish. Make a Strike with a required weapon or grapple with a net. If the attack hits, you can attempt an Athletics check check against the target's Fortitude DC. On a success, you pull the target 10 feet closer to you.
